m_questTitle: Take Me Down to Velo City

m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: What kinda measly Myth Monster are you? Eh, well, you ain't gettin' through my Deputies.
Wait, wait, everybody stop. This person fights too smart for a Myth Monster. Come on over here, stranger, let's chat.
Well, you may not be a monster, but you sure fight like one. Pleased to meet you. Welcome to the crown jewel of Neumia... Velo City.
It's a work in progress. Anyhow, what you need? Nimbari? Yep, a squad of them came through a while ago.
Said they came to stop all the Myth Monsters. They just stomped right in, got a guide from the Hunters Guild and stomped right out.
Typical. Guess they never heard of manners. Anyhow, if you're looking for them, check with Head Hunter Hiram in the Guild.
And if you want another scrap, you know where to find us.
You've come to find the Nimbari Patrol, huh? They were all eaten by Humongishfrogs. Least that's what Newt over there's been saying.
He ain't quite right anymore. Helped lead the Nimbs to the worst monster spots on the Plains and he came back like this.
Nimbs just don't get it. They like it high up in their city; they don't live the hunt like we do. It ain't just a mission; the hunt is alive.
And it's right ticked off. The Turbines, the mirrors, the controlling the weather - it ain't natural. And it's all unbalanced the hunt.
So nature compensates with bigger, badder monsters to gobble 'em up. Least that's what I think. Newt'll know more, if you can get it out of him.
They mostly come at night... mostly, bouncing to his commanding croak. One-by-one, hop-by-hop until doom comes to us all.
You seek the Nimbari? They're gone! Fodder for the frogs. And there is no fighting the frogs.
You say a Nimbari Squad came to solve our Myth Monster problem? That's darn decent of 'em. That weapon in the tunnel don't bode well, though. Hmm-mm.
But maybe they found something out. If they were interested in the Myth Monsters, they were on the same path you are. They might have a lead.
Seems like they were working with the Hunters Guild. So if you want to know what happened here, you should ask at their base in Velo City.
I'm going to take a nap, dream until my good dreams come true. I'm too old for this livin' on the edge. Monster fightin' is a young man's sport.
When children are naughty and keep on... huh? Why're you still here? Get to Velo City already.
